description: 36 independent Arial paragraph controls regenerated in the native reference application on 2026-09-19. Fonts 12/24pt; 90%/200%/3pt line spacing; before/after spacing 0/50/100%. All have two paragraphs. Natural height plus the independently verified TX height search reproduces native geometry. Mixed-font controls were also inspected to establish first/last-line dependence; their existing line-placement differences are not represented as exact whole-height regressions here. Native drawing geometry is expected output only.
